Canberra

Canberra is the capital city of Australia. It was selected as the site of the national capital in 1908 as a compromise between Sydney and Melbourne, the two largest cities, and Parliament first met there in 1927.

The city is located at the northern end of the Australian Capital Territory and had an estimated population of about 470,000 people. Café culture is lively.
